Phonable replaces your carrier voicemail on iPhone and fixes both sides of a missed call. Your caller gets a text after a missed call, so they know why you couldn't pick up, even if they hang up without leaving a voicemail. You get the gist: voicemails arrive transcribed with a short AI summary. Switch modes like Workday, Driving or Gym in one tap or on a schedule, greet callers in your own voice or a natural AI voice, and keep your own number. [...] Hi Product Hunt! I'm Frits, the maker of Phonable.  
  
A missed call leaves both sides hanging. Your caller doesn't know why you didn't pick up or when you'll call back, and you're left with a missed call and maybe a voicemail you have to sit through.  
  
Phonable replaces your carrier voicemail and handles both sides:  
- Your caller gets a text after a missed call, even if they hang up without leaving a voicemail  
- If they do leave one, you get a transcript and a short AI summary  
- Modes like Workday, Driving, Gym and Weekend set your greeting and text in one tap, or switch on by schedule  
- Greet callers in your own recorded voice or a natural AI voice  
- Keep your own number: your carrier forwards missed calls, and setup takes about a minute [...] I'd love your feedback, especially on which modes you'd want next. Happy to answer any questions!
